name: review-inbox
description: Your GitHub work in a drawer: PRs waiting for your review, each summarized in plain language, your open PRs with their reviews, and your issues

scope.title: Search scope
scope.description: GitHub search qualifiers that narrow every tab, e.g. org:my-org or repo:owner/name; empty watches every repository

githubUser.title: GitHub account
githubUser.description: gh account to use when several are logged in; empty uses the active one

language.title: Language
language.description: Language of the band, drawer, toasts and summaries; auto follows Claude Code's language setting, then the system locale, then English

refreshMinutes.title: Refresh interval
refreshMinutes.description: Minutes between fetches from GitHub, shared by every session

repoPaths.title: Repository folders
repoPaths.description: Where Claude works on each repository, comma-separated: owner/repo=~/code/repo or owner/*=~/code/*; wins over the folders the mod remembers

motion.title: Motion
motion.description: auto flashes a band count that goes down unless Claude Code's reduced motion setting is on; off never does

directActions.title: Direct GitHub actions
directActions.description: on adds buttons that write to GitHub from a card: Approve, Ready for review and Update branch after a confirm on the card, Rerun failed CI and Assign me at once; off leaves every write to Claude

autoReview.title: Auto review
autoReview.description: on reviews each PR that asks for you directly in the background, one at a time, once autoReviewSettleMinutes (30 by default) have passed since its latest commit, and keeps the result as your pending review until you post it from the card. This is only where it starts: once the Auto review button atop the Review tab is pressed, the button alone turns it on and off. Each review runs a subagent with your CLAUDE.md, hooks and listed skills, and uses noticeably more tokens

autoReviewPost.title: Auto review posting
autoReviewPost.description: What a finished review becomes: pending keeps it as your pending review to post from the card, comment posts it as a comment, verdict posts it with the verdict it suggests, approve and request changes included

autoReviewModel.title: Auto review model
autoReviewModel.description: The model the reviewer subagent runs on; opus reviews deeper and costs more

autoReviewVerify.title: Auto review check
autoReviewVerify.description: on has a second reviewer check each finding of a draft against the code before it is stored, dropping what does not hold and lowering what is overstated; a review with findings costs about twice the tokens

autoReviewDaily.title: Auto reviews a day
autoReviewDaily.description: Most reviews auto review starts in a day; Try again on a card is not counted

autoReviewSettleMinutes.title: Auto review wait
autoReviewSettleMinutes.description: Minutes after a PR's latest commit before auto review starts on it, since authors often push again right after asking; 0 starts as soon as it is seen

autoReviewSkills.title: Auto review skills
autoReviewSkills.description: Skills loaded into the reviewer, comma-separated, such as a review playbook; empty loads none

autoReviewInstructions.title: Auto review instructions
autoReviewInstructions.description: Your own words to the reviewer, such as what to check first or how to word comments; empty adds none

autoReviewSeverityNames.title: Auto review severity names
autoReviewSeverityNames.description: What the four severities are called on a review, blocker to nit, comma-separated, such as Blocker, Decision needed, Follow-up, nit; empty uses the language's own

autoReviewLarge.title: Auto review large PRs
autoReviewLarge.description: on also reviews PRs over 50 files or 2,000 changed lines, which can take many more tokens; off leaves them alone

autoReviewMaxTurns.title: Auto review turn limit
autoReviewMaxTurns.description: How many turns the reviewer may take before it must answer; a large PR can need more, and a review that runs out fails without one, saying so on its card

autoReviewTools.title: Auto review tools
autoReviewTools.description: What the reviewer may use: read keeps it to reading the diff and the code; all gives it every tool of your session under its permissions, as when you ask for a review yourself, so it can run tests and commands, but a pull request's text can then try to steer them

autoReviewBacklog.title: Auto review older requests
autoReviewBacklog.description: on also reviews requests made before auto review was turned on, a few a day as autoReviewDaily allows; off leaves them alone
